_comment: Measured outcomes against PROTOCOL.md. Nothing here redefines the design; it only records what was observed. Off-ledger exploration goes in FINDINGS.md, never here.

M1.note: Town01 (A3). Lit/unlit resolved (A4): site 1 unlit at 4.5, site 3 lit at 25.7 mean brightness, night lamps off

M2.note: a_max 0.868 g, t_lat 0.150 s over 10 reps/speed; contact detector -1.23 ft on a deliberate crash; oracle 10/10 perfect and 0/10 late

M3.note: expert 10/10 at both regulatory endpoints, outcomes identical across lighting; scenario objects built and both oracle checks pass

M4.note: both policies 10/10 at both regulatory endpoints, braking at 33.6 ft against r_req 34.7, standoff 5.4-5.5 ft

M5.note: both gates pass behaviourally for BOTH policies: capture 0.191 (P_cont) / 0.260 (P_pts); in-between worst 0.454 (P_cont) / 0.578 (P_pts) over covered sub-intervals, failing only inside the A6-excluded sliver (FINDINGS F2)

M6.note: both properties, both policies, verdicts committed before driving. S: P_pts 6/11, P_cont 8/11. A: P_pts 6/11, P_cont 8/11

M7.note: P_pts 10/11 agreement, P_cont 9/11, every disagreement conservative. P_pts drove 0/10 at three dusk illuminations where P_cont drove 10/10, 10/10, 5/10

M8.note: figure and full report done (docs/STUDY_REPORT.md, docs/figures/dusk_gap.html); paper not drafted
